name: briefbar-pr-order
description: Lets the sessions that open pull requests tell BriefBar, without being asked, the order those that go together must merge in and each one's stage, so that its Pull Requests pages show what's next. A skill, which uses BriefBar's MCP server. It comes with BriefBar.app, which installs it when you turn on Pull Request Order in its Settings, and updates it with itself.
